newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slide for eighth day.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slide for eighth day.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.40 percent on Wednesday, slipping for eight trading sessions in a row, as an absence of foreign investors continued to discourage activity.
"Trading activity will remain at such poor levels as long as costs of setting up custody accounts remain unknown," one trader said.
The central bank ordered international investors to open custody accounts at Slovenian banks if they want to trade in Slovenian securities.
* The SBI index fell 5.42 points to 1,362.1.
* Overall 10 shares fell, six rose and two were unchanged, while eight were untraded.
* Bank SKB was the most active share, easing 0.36 percent to 55,000 tolars on volume of 838 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
